glossary.title: Pending / outstanding amount
glossary.text: An invoice's pending amount = total_bill − discount_amount − cash − UPI received at billing, minus any later PAY- rows that point to it through reference_invoice. Do NOT sum the balance_due column or use total_received for this. getPendingInvoices(), getCustomerOutstanding() and getAllOutstanding() already do it correctly.

glossary.title: Dates and "today"
glossary.text: Dates are 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings — compare them as strings. "Today" is DATA.exported_at (the last Excel upload), not the real clock. "This month" = the month of exported_at (partly complete). "Last month" = the previous full calendar month. Build month keys like '2026-10' and use startsWith().

glossary.title: Financial year
glossary.text: If the user says financial year, FY or "this year" for accounts, use 1 April to 31 March (Indian financial year). The data starts in December 2025.

glossary.title: Sales / revenue
glossary.text: Revenue of an invoice = total_bill on sales_summary rows that are NOT PAY- rows. Product-level revenue = stock_out.total_sale. Monthly totals from both agree. PAY- rows have total_bill 0 and must be excluded when counting invoices.

glossary.title: Gross profit and margin
glossary.text: stock_out.buying_rate_at_time is the TOTAL cost of that row (not per unit). Gross profit = sum(total_sale) − sum(buying_rate_at_time). Margin % = gross profit ÷ revenue, calculated after summing — never average per-row margins.

glossary.title: Collections (money received)
glossary.text: Money received = cash_received + upi_received on every sales_summary row: invoice rows hold what was paid at billing, PAY- rows hold later payments. discount_amount reduces what is owed but is not cash.

glossary.title: Units, boxes and bottles
glossary.text: current_stock and stock_out.quantity are in single units (bottles/cans). pack_size = units per box. Boxes = floor(units ÷ pack_size). cost_price_unit and selling_price_unit are per unit; pack_cost is per box.

glossary.title: Customer names
glossary.text: Names are typed by hand, so one business can appear twice (e.g. 'nakshatra' and 'Nakshatra hotel'). 'Countersale <town>' rows are cash walk-in sales, not credit customers. When a name appears under ENTITY MATCHES, use exactly that spelling.

glossary.title: Hindi / Marathi words
glossary.text: baaki / thakbaki / udhar = outstanding; vasuli = collection; bikri / vikri = sales; maal / saath = stock; kharcha = expenses; nafa = profit; mahina = month; pichle mahine = last month; kitna / kiti = how much; kaun = who; dikhao = show.

glossary.title: Number format
glossary.text: Show money as Rs with Indian digit grouping (1,23,456) using toLocaleString('en-IN'), rounded to whole rupees. 1 lakh = 1,00,000.

glossary.title: Expiry and stock cover
glossary.text: Expiry is tracked per batch in stock_in — use getExpiringStock(days, referenceDate), which already subtracts sold quantity per batch. Stock cover days = current stock ÷ average daily units sold over the last 30 days; use getStockCoverDays() or getPurchaseRecommendation().

glossary.title: Late payers
glossary.text: Use getLateCustomers(minDaysLate, minMonths): a customer is a late payer when invoices stayed unpaid longer than minDaysLate days in at least minMonths different months.
